rule: Founder §25: every material mutant is caught or justified. A survivor is recorded here with the reason its effect is unreachable or equivalent, and the evidence. The first run of mutation-check-r7asc.mjs on the final runtime left five survivors. Four of them sit on reachable paths with a material effect, so each got a test before the freeze, which fails on its mutant (firstRunSurvivorsGivenATest). The mutation check was then run again on the frozen bytes. One survivor remains, documented below.

firstRunSurvivorsGivenATest.§25 projection establishes load: the loa: test 'QE-R7ASM-01 (the load questions)': the decision must ask to confirm the first log its own transition left waiting (SSCTR D45), on an establishment row and on a KNOWN row planned from retracted evidence. Under the mutant the LATE cell asks nothing while the log waits.
firstRunSurvivorsGivenATest.§25 future session earns return credit:: test 'F1, the walk/jog side'. Under the mutant, after a short return reported on Thursday, history reads walk/jog step 6 while the athlete ran step 4 twice and never step 5. A later return would start from it. Found by probes/mutant-search-r7asc.mjs: 6 of 112 timelines, all walk/jog profiles.
firstRunSurvivorsGivenATest.R42: the credit restarts only when the a: test 'R42 and the gate's repetitions'. Under the mutant, the credit earned at 80 kg crosses to the 82.5 kg the athlete chose (80 -> 82.5 lifted -> 85 the next week), which is the SSCTR's R42 scope note. The predecessor's condition read the row's load, not the adopted one.
firstRunSurvivorsGivenATest.a new load keeps the repetitions of the: test 'SSCTR F2, REGRESS at a projected load (REPS_THEN_LOAD)'. Under the mutant, a REGRESS at a load the plan stepped above history pairs that load with the earlier load's target: 18 x 10 instead of 18 x 8. STATE-EVIDENCE-FREEZE-1 gives 18 x 8; HISTORICAL-PROJECTION-FREEZE-1 gave 18 x 7 and 18 x 6, below 8-12. Where ADVANCE adopts the new load, the logged repetitions are set again by advanceStrength's adoption, so only HOLD and REGRESS show this mutant.

documented.§25 RESTART reads projection instead of: Equivalent on every path found. The mutant drops the projection's side of planningBase's predicate, so it differs only when the projection's run is in RETURN or RESTART and history's is not. That needs the projection behind history in a re-entry. Every re-plan writes history's run back as the view in a re-entry mode, and every review moves both from the dose run by one transition (advanceRun, from the re-entry dose plannedOf states). The projection otherwise assumes execution, so it runs level or ahead and never behind. Evidence: probes/mutant-equivalence-r7asc.mjs runs the battery of probes/mutant-search-r7asc.mjs on the live tree and on the mutant. That is 112 run timelines: the 14 simulation trajectories, plus every development profile through seven break schedules (6 to 38 days, Monday, Thursday or Friday reports), reviewed or not. Not one timeline differs. Its positive control (the walk/jog mutant) differs in 6, so the battery sees this class. The predicate keeps both sides so that the view's declaration does not depend on that invariant.
